# Aurora Planner budget and forecast

Finance approved budget version 2.1 on 2026-04-10. The earlier 2026-04-08 planning sheet was a proposal and is not the approved baseline.
The approved total budget is $24,000. This envelope includes planned allocations and a separately held contingency reserve.
Engineering is allocated $10,000 for calendar behavior, export reliability, and release support.
Design is allocated $8,000 for pilot feedback, accessibility review, and final interaction updates.
QA and validation have a separate approved allocation of $4,000. The test plan uses the same $4,000 as its spending ceiling; it is not an additional amount on top of the QA allocation.
A $2,000 contingency reserve remains unassigned. It is part of the $24,000 approved envelope, but it is not available as a team allocation unless finance approves its use.
The allocations total $22,000 before contingency: $10,000 engineering, $8,000 design, and $4,000 QA and validation. Do not describe that subtotal as the full approved budget.
The 2026-04-08 proposal suggested $5,000 for QA and $1,000 for contingency. Finance replaced those figures in version 2.1; they are historical proposal values, not current approved amounts.
Purchase orders and forecast actuals are tracked elsewhere. This note records the approved project envelope and allocations, not the amount already spent or the vendors paid.
